$comment: A real-model check for the cross-GPU step-time row (Chiya's review, Nov 2): C's four campaign cells of the zoo LoRA script measured on the A10 (docs/status/c.md D17, GitHub run 41493588241), against the engine predicting the A10 from PF102's record, measured on the L4 only. lr doesn't move step time, so the two lr cells at each batch are both kept. step_s is each cell's p50 over 14 timed steps.
